summary: This diff adds pure infrastructure for the ChatGPT Prompt Library (sandbox guard, CSV schema doc, coverage/duplicate-detection scripts, and registry/blocker entries) with no real prompt generation performed, which is honest given the confirmed absence of a real OPENAI_API_KEY in /opt/veridian/shared/.env. I independently ran all three new scripts: chatgpt_promptlib_guard.py correctly creates the 15-subfolder sandbox and rejects both relative path-traversal (../../etc/passwd) and absolute-path (/etc/passwd) escape attempts via realpath-based prefix checking; generate_prompt_coverage_report.py correctly shells out to the real superboss-register.py list-capabilities CLI (verified the capability_name field and list-capabilities subcommand exist) and produces an honest 0pct baseline against the 10 live capabilities; detect_prompt_duplicates.py's --test-fixture correctly finds the planted duplicate pair and does not flag the distinct row. All four new/modified YAML files parse as valid YAML. No .github/workflows/** changes, no migrations/schema.sql/auth/.env writes, no heavy deletions, so the tier1 classification is correct. Architecture is sound: all filesystem writes route through a single sandboxed guard module, subprocess calls use argument lists (no shell=True, no injection risk), and the diff avoids fabricating a substitute LLM provider in place of the Owner-specified ChatGPT, correctly deferring the actual generation step and filing an OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED entry instead.
